description: Business process dependency graph between smart factory subsystems (static scenario data, not runtime gateway component)

dependencies.description: Production line can only run if valid material batch (RFID valid) is available from Warehouse.
Production quality depends on ambient temperature and humidity remaining within environmental tolerances.
Production line must be halted (held) if machine health is critical or Emergency Stop is engaged on N4.
Output goods from Production trigger warehouse dock gate actuation and inventory transfer.
